name: TBETS (segmented)
description: MCTS over phase genomes (one gene sequence per searched phase: purchase, combat move or noncombat move; heterogeneous-mcts's atomic actions as genes): root = current state, its children genomes of the current phase, every node's children genomes of the next phase (purchase -> combat -> noncombat -> next player's purchase). Expansion at the UCB1-selected leaf: TBETS_GREEDY_PCT % a child (the next phase's greedy genome), otherwise a mutated sibling; every node with children passed through gets one mutated sibling per visit; greedy rollouts of TBETS_ROLLOUT rounds.
